drafted_from: tool:keep-new-arc-tabs-in-the-inspiration-library's own row (its words, input schema and output schema) and the runner's tests on a fixture sidebar and a stub browser; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep the new tabs from my Arc browser in my inspiration library, design and site ones first", with {"sidebar":"<the Arc folder>/StorableSidebar.json","obscura":"<the Obscura program>","limit":2}. It runs tool:keep-new-arc-tabs-in-the-inspiration-library and answers the counts (tabs read, unique addresses, held, new by kind, screenshots taken) and the new rows with one entry per screenshot.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours. It reads a copy of the Arc sidebar file and the addresses your library already holds, and answers the rows and the SQL that keeps them in inspiration_items; the tool itself keeps nothing in the database.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep the new tabs from my Arc browser in my inspiration library, design and site ones first", and give it the state folder, the Arc sidebar file and the Obscura program (the worked example shows the values).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-new-arc-tabs-in-the-inspiration-library and that input.

3. Read what comes back: counts (tabs, unique, held, new, byKind, shots_ok, shots_failed), waited (the load-gate waits), rows (the new library rows, for one parameterised insert) and shot_rows (one entry per screenshot: its Files name, or failed). The screenshots themselves come back as the declared output out/shots.json.

4. Write the rows into your own database with one parameterised insert, then update each shot row's screenshot_file_name and screenshot_blake3 and keep the shots in Files from out/shots.json. The tool never writes the database itself.

5. Chat threads (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and the rest) keep their title and provider and are marked to mine later; they are never opened or screenshotted. Mail, calendar, documents, search and account pages keep the host only.

worked_examples.title: New tabs from the Arc sidebar, two screenshots
worked_examples.ask: Keep the new tabs from my Arc browser in my inspiration library, design and site ones first
worked_examples.given: A sidebar file with a design site (refero.design/x), a chat thread (chatgpt.com/c/abc), a mail page and a video; nothing held yet.
worked_examples.hands_back: counts: tabs 6, unique 5, held 0, new 5, shots_ok 2 (the design site and the flow); rows: 5 rows for one insert; shot_rows: two entries with a Files name; out/shots.json holds the two screenshots. The chat thread row keeps its title and provider and is marked to mine later; the mail row keeps the host only.
